description: Definitive, opinionated best practices for robust, performant, maintainable cross-platform mobile apps with Expo.

Structure: `assets/` static assets; `src/` app logic; `src/components/` reusable UI; `src/screens/` distinct views; `src/navigation/` (if not using Expo Router `app/`); `src/hooks/` hooks; `src/utils/` utilities/constants; `src/services/` API/data.

Naming: dirs `kebab-case`; components `PascalCase`; variables/functions `camelCase`; constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`.

Functional+TS+styles: **Functional Components with Hooks:** Always use functional components. class MyComponent extends React.Component { /* ... */ } ; const MyComponent: React.FC = () => { /* ... */ }; **TypeScript for Type Safety:** All new code must be in TypeScript. function greet(name) { return `Hello, ${name}`; } ; const greet = (name: string): string => `Hello, ${name}`; **Styling with `StyleSheet`:** Centralize styles for readability and performance. <Text style={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'blue' }}>Hello</Text> import { StyleSheet, Text } from 'react-native'; const MyComponent = () => <Text style={styles.text}>Hello</Text>; const styles = StyleSheet.create({ text: { fontSize: 16, color: 'blue' } });

Routing: **File-System Based Routing:** Use `app/` directory for routing. ❌ BAD: Manual stack/tab navigator setup in a single file for all routes. // app/_layout.tsx import { Stack } from 'expo-router'; export default function RootLayout() { } //
